sloka: अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव ।सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः ।। ७.१०४.१५ ॥
transliteration: atha vā vijigīṣā te suralokāya rāghava ।sanāthā viṣṇunā devā bhavantu vigatajvarāḥ ।। 7.104.15 ॥

translations.english: Or, O Raghava, if you desire to return to the world of the gods, then may the gods be protected by Vishnu and be free from all distress.
